Lena (CSM): Marta — quick pulse on ApexFin onboarding. Were seeing peak-hour tail latency spike ~30% on your /generate route yesterday evening. Renewal is in 6 weeks, so want to be proactive. Any constraints on canarying a model swap or enabling more aggressive batching?

Marta (ApexFin): Were on Private in us-central, and the compliance team requires model binaries be vetted, but otherwise open. Peak is ~17:00-18:30 local, traffic pattern is long-form invoice summaries (~35% of calls >512 tokens). Throughput is capped by current reserved slots. No change to throughput limits unless Redwood recommends a config that keeps latency SLOs.

Diego (Solutions Eng): Ok. Two paths with low friction: 1) swap long-form route to a more memory-efficient variant (redwood/assistant-medium-4b-q4), 2) enable dynamic batching with smaller max_batch_latency for long gens to reduce p95. Also enable selective prefix caching for invoice templates. Example route rules we can apply:```yaml
routes:
  - match: {type: "invoice_summary", tokens: ">512"}
    target: redwood/assistant-medium-4b-q4
  - match: {type: "short_ack", tokens: "<80"}
    target: redwood/assistant-lite-1.3b
inference:
  dynamic_batching:
    max_batch_latency_ms: 12
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  keys: ["invoice_template_v2"]
```

Nina (Product): Recommend a conservative canary: 2% -> 10% over 6 hours, with checks on p95, error_rate, and a small quality smoke test on 50 golden invoices. Auto-rollback if any quality metric drops >3% or p95 increases >15%. We'll also run a token-usage probe to estimate cost delta for renewal notes.

Marta (ApexFin): 2% ok. Vetting timeline: needs security checksum and a compliance review sign-off; we can do that in 48h. Also prefer the canary to avoid overlapping with nightly batch jobs that run at 02:00 UTC.

Diego (Solutions Eng): We'll produce a vetted q4 build for your private instance and a canary config. Canary snippet:```json
{
  "canary": {"start_pct": 2, "target_pct": 10, "ramp_hours": 6},
  "monitors": ["p95","error_rate","quality_score"],
  "rollback": {"p95_pct_increase": 15, "quality_drop_pct": 3}
}
```

infra-bot: Notice: Private patch window scheduled for us-central on 1981236000 (maintenance). Rollouts will be paused during the window.

Lena (CSM): Action items -> Diego to build vetable q4 artifact and push canary config; Nina to add 50 golden invoice prompts and token probe; Marta to schedule compliance window and confirm no overlap with maintenance. I'll coordinate a 30-min enablement session for next Tuesday 16:00 CT.

Marta (ApexFin): Sounds good. On renewal: if we can cut p95 by ~20% during peak without meaningful quality loss, that strengthens our expansion case. We'll capture the before/after in the renewal packet.

Diego (Solutions Eng): Also note: if reserved slots are the bottleneck, we can suggest short-term burst capacity to avoid queueing, but that has cost implications. Will surface numbers in the playbook. Rollback command for quick abort: `redwood rollout abort --route /generate --to stable`.

Nina (Product): Please share the 50 prompts by EOD so we can bake them into the eval. We'll include a simple A/B on summary length and factual completeness.

Lena (CSM): Thanks team. Capturing for records: goal = reduce peak p95 by 15-25% and lower tokens per long-gen by ~10-18% with no >3% quality regression. Will update the renewal brief after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
